newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CND meeting will decide CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CND meeting will decide CVRD sale.

text.p: Today's meeting of the National Privatization Council (CND) will conclude auction details for mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), said National Development Bank (BNDES) privatization director Jose Pio Borges.
Borges told reporters the privatization will go ahead in April and that the bid specifications would be made public in February.
Asked if Wednesday's meeting of the CND would be a long one, he replied, "It will."
The CND began meeting shortly before 1600 local/1800 GMT, and is expected to set the base price for CVRD.
